config.subject: A robot discovering a forgotten garden in a cyberpunk city
config.style_details: High contrast, neon lights, rain-slicked surfaces
config.task_description: Generate comic book for 'A robot discovering a forgotten garden in a cyberpunk city'

script.title: The Silicon Bloom
script.premise: In the heart of Neo-Kowloon, a city of eternal rain and chrome, a discarded maintenance drone named "Unit 7" follows a leak in the cooling pipes to find something impossible: a living, breathing sanctuary of green hidden beneath the steel.

characters.name: Unit 7 (Seven)
characters.description: An obsolete "Scrubber-Class" maintenance robot. He is built for utility, not aesthetics.
characters.visual_traits: Boxy, rusted chassis with exposed wiring at the joints. He has a single, large circular optic sensor that glows a soft, flickering cyan. One of his hydraulic arms is slightly misaligned, giving him a limping gait.

frames.description: A wide shot of a narrow alleyway between two massive skyscrapers. Neon signs for "SYNTH-OIL" and "NEURAL-LINK" reflect in oily puddles.
frames.caption: Neo-Kowloon doesn’t sleep. It just hums. A billion circuits screaming for more power.

frames.description: A medium shot of Unit 7. He is hunched over, dragging a heavy magnetic broom through the sludge. His optic sensor is dimmed.
frames.caption: I am a part of the hum. A ghost in the machine.

frames.description: Close-up on Unit 7’s optic. A small, vibrant green reflection appears in the center of his lens, clashing with the surrounding neon.

rows.visual_description: A wide, cinematic introduction to the city. The color palette is dominated by deep blacks, electric blues, and harsh neon pinks. Rain falls in heavy, vertical streaks. The architecture is oppressive and jagged.

frames.description: Unit 7 pushes aside a heavy, rusted ventilation grate. Steam billows out from the darkness. SFX: SCREEEEE-CLANG
Unit 7 crawls through a narrow tunnel of pipes. His chassis is covered in grime. He is looking toward a soft, warm light at the end of the tunnel.
frames.caption: The blueprints say there is only solid foundation here. The blueprints are lying.

rows.visual_description: The lighting shifts from the broad neon of the street to the claustrophobic shadows of a crawlspace. High contrast "Chiaroscuro" lighting—heavy blacks with sharp highlights on the robot’s metallic edges.

frames.description: Unit 7 stands at the edge of a massive, glass-domed room. Vines wrap around rusted server racks. A single, ancient oak tree stands in the center, its leaves glowing faintly from bioluminescent moss. Rain taps gently against the cracked glass dome above.
frames.caption: It’s a glitch in the city’s code. A beautiful, silent error.

rows.visual_description: A breathtaking reveal. The row is a single, large frame (Splash Row). The colors shift from cold blues to warm, earthy greens and soft yellows. A hidden atrium, once a luxury penthouse garden, now overgrown and wild.

frames.description: Close-up on Unit 7’s rusted hand. He is gently touching the petal of a wild rose. The red of the flower is the most vibrant color on the page.

A wide silhouette shot. Unit 7 sits down at the base of the tree, his back against the bark. Above the glass dome, the harsh neon lights of the city towers loom like predatory eyes, but they cannot reach him here.
frames.caption: The city wants to pave over everything. But today... I think I’ll forget to report the leak.

rows.visual_description: Focus on the tactile contrast between the cold robot and the soft nature. The mood is quiet, reverent, and melancholic.
